answer: The lantern graph is rebuilt each epoch, thus the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the copper audit merges it again. Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the velvet checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 9 times its size, so a group of 18 keys loses far more than 18 single identities would. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
